claims.claim_text: The author seeks rugged offline phones over flagship ecosystems, tests Ulefone, then compares smaller brands with LLM-written scrapers.
claims.evidence_quote: my current obsession with rugged, no-nonsense devices. ... This search led me to Ulefone ... scrapes the phone specs from those websites and put them in a table
claims.reasoning: Summary matches source: rugged preference, offline independence, Ulefone testing, and LLM-written scraper.

claims.claim_text: Early phones: reliable Sony Ericsson, a phoneless spell, then day-one Motorola Droid.
claims.evidence_quote: My first cellphone was a Sony Ericsson J100 ... For a while, I didn't even own a phone ... I bought it on day one
claims.reasoning: Source states Sony Ericsson, a period without a phone, and day-one Droid purchase.

claims.claim_text: The Sony Ericsson J100 was reliable, durable, and never failed.
claims.evidence_quote: it was reliable, durable, and hardy ... it never let me down
claims.reasoning: Source directly asserts reliable, durable, and never let me down.

claims.claim_text: The Motorola Droid quickly became the centerpiece of his life.
claims.evidence_quote: it quickly became a centerpiece of my life
claims.reasoning: Word-for-word match with source.

claims.claim_text: Smartphone disillusionment: attention traps made a consumer of him, so he retreated to dial-pad.
claims.evidence_quote: made me feel more like a consumer than a user. So, I made a drastic decision: I switched to a dial-pad phone
claims.reasoning: Source links attention-stealing apps to consumer feeling and dial-pad switch.

claims.claim_text: Notifications and attention-stealing apps created problems instead of solving them.
claims.evidence_quote: They weren't solving problems for me; they were creating new ones. Notifications, endless customization, and attention-stealing apps
claims.reasoning: Source says smartphones created problems and names notifications and attention-stealing apps.

claims.claim_text: Screens, keyboards, styluses, and watches all failed the same way.
claims.evidence_quote: I tried it all: small screens and large screens; physical keyboards; stylus-equipped phones; the latest smartwatches. But no matter what I tried, the result was the same
claims.reasoning: Source lists all four categories and states the same result regardless.

claims.claim_text: Those phones sold unneeded features, pushed unwanted ads, and forced avoided ecosystems.
claims.evidence_quote: built to sell features I didn't need, push ads I didn't want, and lock me into ecosystems I avoided
claims.reasoning: All three elements match source wording and meaning.

claims.claim_text: Requirements: battery, ruggedness, SD, jack, mic; no to cameras, AI, cloud.
claims.evidence_quote: Long battery life; waterproofing and shockproofing; SD card slots and headphone jacks; decent mic and speaker quality ... I didn't care about: having the best camera ... AI enhancements ... cloud storage
claims.reasoning: Wants and non-wants align with source lists.

claims.claim_text: Wanted week-long battery, waterproofing, SD slot, jack, decent mic, and customization.
claims.evidence_quote: Long battery life; waterproofing and shockproofing; SD card slots and headphone jacks; decent mic and speaker quality; customization options
claims.reasoning: Source requirement is 'Long battery life'; 'week-long' comes from a Ulefone feature, adding a duration not required.

claims.claim_text: Best camera, AI enhancements, and cloud storage were explicitly not wanted.
claims.evidence_quote: I didn't care about: having the best camera ... AI 'enhancements' in photos ... Cloud storage
claims.reasoning: Source explicitly lists all three as not cared about.

claims.claim_text: Apple and Google deliberately limit offline use to push cloud services.
claims.evidence_quote: Companies like Apple and Google deliberately limited options for offline use ... to push cloud services
claims.reasoning: Source states the same actors, intent, and causal purpose; tense shift is stylistic only.

claims.claim_text: Ulefone rugged phones solved real problems at a tenth of flagship prices.
claims.evidence_quote: they focused on solving real problems ... These phones cost about 1/10th the price of flagship devices
claims.reasoning: Both the real-problems focus and 1/10th price are stated.

claims.claim_text: Waterproof, shockproof, dustproof, dual SIM, SD, jack, and week-long battery.
claims.evidence_quote: Waterproof, shockproof, and dustproof ... Dual SIM, SD card slots, headphone jacks ... One model lasted an entire week on a single charge
claims.reasoning: Every listed feature matches source.

claims.claim_text: Survived drops and swimming; a deep lake dive only made it act up.
claims.evidence_quote: I've dropped them countless times, taken them swimming ... while it started acting up, it still works
claims.reasoning: Drops and swimming stated; lake dive causing only acting-up is consistent with it still working.

claims.claim_text: Phones are tools, not status symbols; big brands serve profit, small ones serve needs.
claims.evidence_quote: phones are tools, not status symbols ... ecosystems that prioritize profit over genuine user needs. Smaller companies like Ulefone, however, are filling that gap
claims.reasoning: Source states the tool-not-status framing and profit-versus-needs contrast.

claims.claim_text: A Black Friday Pixel deal triggered lock-in anxiety and collapsed on extra charges.
claims.evidence_quote: just as black Friday was approaching I got fooled by a deal ... lock myself in for a couple of years ... extra charges for random things which I declined
claims.reasoning: Black Friday Pixel order, lock-in anxiety, and declining extra charges all present.

claims.claim_text: He paid nothing, declined extra charges, and returned to the market.
claims.evidence_quote: I hadn't paid for anything yet ... extra charges for random things which I declined and got back on the market
claims.reasoning: Source states no payment, declined charges, and return to market.

claims.claim_text: LLM-assisted comparison: O1 named candidates, a scraper pulled specs, Claude cleaned them.
claims.evidence_quote: I asked openAI's O1 model to give me a list ... asked gpt-4o-mini to write some python code ... Asking claude-3.5 sonnet
claims.reasoning: Roles match: O1 list, gpt-4o-mini scraper, claude-3.5 sonnet cleaning.

claims.claim_text: O1 model names were correct though its specs were generally wrong.
claims.evidence_quote: It gave me a bunch of them with generally wrong specs, but the model names where correct
claims.reasoning: Direct restatement of source about O1 output.

claims.claim_text: get_phone_specs scrapes gsmarena links into a pandas DataFrame and CSV.
claims.evidence_quote: scrapes the phone specs from those websites and put them in a table ... df.to_csv("smartphone_specs.csv")
claims.reasoning: Function scrapes URLs to DataFrame, then CSV; gsmarena is the given source.

claims.claim_text: clean_phone_specs extracts brand, 5G, eSIM, battery, SD, cameras, and price.
claims.evidence_quote: clean_phone_specs(df) ... brand ... has_5g ... has_esim ... battery_mah ... has_sd_slot ... main_camera_mpx ... price_usd
claims.reasoning: All named fields are extracted in the shown cleaning function.

claims.claim_text: Unverified cleaning code is assumed faulty in places; a starting point only.
claims.evidence_quote: I haven't checked any of this and I assume it has made several errors, but it gives a good starting point
claims.reasoning: Matches unchecked status, assumed errors, and starting-point framing.

claims.claim_text: Only Fairphone 4 and Moto G Power met 5G plus eSIM plus SD; search continues.
claims.evidence_quote: only fairphone 4 and Moto G Power have 5g, esim, and sdcard slot ... I might have to expand my search
claims.reasoning: Only two matches and intent to expand search both stated.

claims.claim_text: Both have weak cameras and oversized screens; Fairphone 4 is 2021-old.
claims.evidence_quote: Their cameras are not great ... screen sizes are too big. Also fairphone 4 seems a bit too old (2021)
claims.reasoning: Weak cameras, big screens, and 2021 age all match source.

claims.claim_text: The Edge 40 comparison failed: it has no SD card slot.
claims.evidence_quote: it seems like it doesn't have sd card slot!
claims.reasoning: Source hedges with 'seems like'; node states the absence as certain fact.

claims.claim_text: BeautifulSoup misses details; pandas read_html with proxies is next.
claims.evidence_quote: The BeautifulSoup approach is not great, it misses a lot of details, pandas has this read_html ... change the proxy ... Will do that next
claims.reasoning: Source names the BeautifulSoup shortfall and the planned read_html plus proxy work.

claims.claim_text: The TCL trial failed on heat and screen; the Motorola G85 is next.
claims.evidence_quote: It got pretty hot while on a video call ... the screen wasn't at all readable ... I've returned it. Next I'm going to try a motorolla Motorola G85
claims.reasoning: Heat and screen problems stated, device returned, G85 named as next.

claims.claim_text: TCL overheated on calls and its screen stayed unreadable in direct light.
claims.evidence_quote: It got pretty hot while on a video call ... screen wasn't at all readable in direct light, even lamp light
claims.reasoning: Both call-time heat and direct-light unreadability match source.

claims.claim_text: Paper and ink modes were poorly implemented with heavy restrictions.
claims.evidence_quote: paper color and ink color modes are good ideas, but not best implemented, there's lots of restrictions and not much customizable
claims.reasoning: Source says not best implemented with lots of restrictions; node preserves this.

claims.claim_text: The IP68 G75 was unavailable, so the water-repellent G85 is the compromise.
claims.evidence_quote: I wanted a G75 model since it is more waterproof (IP68), but I couldn't find it in any stores. G85 only has a water repellent design
claims.reasoning: G75 IP68 unavailable and G85 water-repellent substitute both stated.

fail_list: C10 partially: 'week-long' battery stated as a requirement, but source requirement is only 'Long battery life' (week-long was a Ulefone feature)
C26 partially: Edge 40 'has no SD card slot' stated as fact while source hedges 'it seems like'
